author: Unreal Engine
description:
Watch this video and discover how French indie studio ZDT used Unreal Engine to create cinematic 2.5D platformer ‘Darwin’s Paradox!’.

‘Darwin’s Paradox!’ revolves around an abducted octopus (named Darwin) whose sole mission is to return home to the ocean. During the journey, players experience a mix of puzzle solving and platforming while taking in Hollywood-quality cinematic sequences that seamlessly blend with the action.

Find out how Blueprint visual scripting, Sequencer, Lumen, and other core Unreal Engine features helped the team bring this innk-credible game to life.
